name: counter-tick
purpose: Acknowledges a discrete value update with a brief visual tick while the host owns number formatting and announcement.

cwvImpact.rationale: The cue is a single opacity and transform transition with no changing dimensions or repeated animation.

accessibility.reducedMotionFallback: Updated values remain visible without a tick transition; the host can continue using its normal live-region policy.

cwvTripwire.layoutShift: Only opacity and transform are transitioned; the value container does not change geometry.
cwvTripwire.longAnimation: A single tick is capped at --dur-1 and cannot repeat autonomously.
